after.message: this accelerator declares no peak for 'bf16'. It declares: fp16. The compute roof has no value without a peak, so there is no number to report and nothing to warn about — and resolving to the nearest supported format would answer a different question than the one asked (build-spec §2.4, ADR 0015 §2). Ask for a precision this part declares, or run it on a part that has one.
